daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be a little selfish today. Your energy is magnetic and people feel it—use it to set boundaries that actually stick. Trust the vibe shift happening within you.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, there's a sweetness in the small moments—notice them. Single? Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Either way, your authenticity is the most attractive thing about you rn.
daily.career: Your ideas have serious potential today, even the ones that feel half-baked. Speak up in that meeting or conversation. Your perspective is exactly what's needed, and the universe is backing your play.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Take a walk, stretch, dance to that song you've been obsessed with. Nourishment looks like listening to what you actually want today.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-discovery, so lean into what feels authentic rather than what looks good on the surface.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about knowing your worth. Someone might test your boundaries—stay grounded. If you're dating, quality over quantity energy is *chef's kiss* right now.
weekly.career: Mercury's got your back with communication vibes. That idea you've been sitting on? Now's the time to pitch it or at least talk it through. Your voice carries more weight than you realize this week.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for genuine rest, not just scrolling in bed. Movement that feels good—dancing, walks, whatever—will shift your whole mood. Hydration is lowkey your secret weapon.
